description: Get calculated daily indicators for one crypto asset: RSI14, MACD(12,26,9), ATR14 absolute and percent, Bollinger(20,2) with %B, returns 7d/30d, 30d/90d highs and lows, and the price distance to each level. Returns only calculated values, never raw candles. Use when you need technical context or mean-reversion/volatility levels. Paid: $0.005 USDC per call via x402. Discover assets with list_assets.

asset.description: Asset id or symbol, e.g. BTC, ETH, SOL, or indicators-btc. Use list_assets to discover supported values.

name: get_indicators
title: Get calculated daily indicators for one asset
